segments.oily: One reviewer with very oily skin says the serum keeps her skin clear with consistent use, and another with combination/mostly-oily skin (humid climate) reports it quickly resolves hormonal breakouts.
segments.dry: Several reviewers describe naturally dry or very dry, dull skin and report the serum absorbs quickly, leaves skin smooth and less dry/dull, though one dry-skin reviewer still found it a bit sticky.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily/combination skin found it unremarkable and preferred her regular face wash, while another with combination, mostly oily skin credits it with clearing hormonal breakouts fast.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin generally report no irritation and good tolerance (including one still monitoring for flare-ups after two weeks), and one used it successfully on a teenager's sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 49 report brighter, tighter, more vibrant skin and fewer visible wrinkles with continued use.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin reviewers (late 30s–49) report brighter, tighter, more vibrant-looking skin and reduced wrinkle appearance with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers with dry or dull skin report improved smoothness, hydration and reduced dullness; one reviewer said skin became dry and dull again when she stopped using it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says it cleared up most of the redness on her face; sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation or increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as non-irritating and compatible with layering under moisturizer, with no reports of compromised barrier function.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report faded dark spots, hyperpigmentation and more even skin tone after weeks of use; one reviewer felt it made no visible difference to her pigmentation and switched to retinol instead.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including teenagers and adults with hormonal or cystic acne history, report clearer skin and fewer breakouts within one to three weeks; a few report no strong effect on their skin overall.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with very oily skin says the product keeps her skin clear without added oiliness; no reviewer reports it made oily skin worse.

extraits.texte: I was desperate for a vitamin C serum that worked on my skin (sensitive and dry) and would help with signs of aging (40 year old). It has brightened my skin over time and helped even my skin tone. My skin does look healthier. However, this wasn't an overnight transformation. It took about 2-3 weeks for the change to be noticeable. It does feel a little sticky on the skin but it absorbs quickly on my dry skin. It doesnt have any smell and layers well with my peptide and moisturizer. The only negative is the price. For now, the results seem to be worth the price but I do think there are some cheaper options out there.
